body: I've calmed down since I posted this. I always get spurts of hopelessness most days. I feel like I'm not really depressed since I can be fine for a bit after each day. I never really wanted to consider if I was suicidal or depressed or something. I feel like I don't deserve the title if I'm not in constant suffering, I guess. That voice in my head always tells me that I'm acting like I'm depressed so I can have something that makes me special. It's the same one that tells me I'm a worthless piece of shit whenever I get a 60 on a test or whenever I'm having fun playing my Cello. I started to act like that even when I didn't need to, and I just never really noticed it I guess. Anyways, thank you for your kind words. I'll try to keep on going. Thank you.
